regime_context: Policy regime is hawkish Fed credibility staging plus Treasury front-end yield suppression plus strategic industrial/defense/energy capital direction. Consensus reads the >70% Sept-hike repricing as simple tightening; revealed interest is an administration that wants lower real yields without near-term cut optics, holding easing as inflation-gated post-midterm optionality. The Iran ceasefire collapse turns the stagflationary split into a live, two-sided oil shock.
regime_context_zh: 政策体制是美联储鹰派可信度铺垫 + 财政部前端收益率抑制 + 战略性的工业/国防/能源资本引导。市场把70%以上的9月加息重定价解读为单纯紧缩；但已揭示的利益是政府希望在不呈现近期降息观感的情况下压低实际收益率，仅在中期选举后以通胀为门槛保留宽松选项。伊朗停火破裂使滞胀分裂成为一个活生生的、双向的石油冲击。

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: Warsh's Fed is holding the hawkish line into the hike-probability repricing: May PCE ran hot and Sept hike odds sit above 70%, with forward guidance deleted. That keeps long-duration nominal yields exposed to inflation and near-term tightening risk, so TLT is likely to lag SPY even if equities also chop.
theses.thesis_zh: Warsh治下的美联储在加息概率重定价中维持鹰派：5月PCE偏热、9月加息概率超过70%，前瞻指引被删除。这使得长久期名义债券暴露于通胀和短期紧缩风险，因此即使股市震荡，TLT也相对SPY更可能落后。
evidence: Fed path: >70% Sept hike probability after Iran, including 50.6% 25bp and 19.6% 50bp
May PCE hot: core +0.3% m/m, 3.4% y/y; headline +0.4% m/m, 4.1% y/y
Warsh Sintra 7/1 held 'prices are too high'; forward guidance buried alongside Lagarde/Bailey/Macklem
theses.dissent: A sharp labor-market crack or an Iran-driven risk-off could force the market to price 2026 cuts, sparking a long-duration rally relative to equities.
theses.dissent_zh: 若就业市场急剧恶化或伊朗局势引发避险，市场可能重新定价2026年降息，从而推动长久期债券相对股票反弹。

falsifier.text: TLT outperforms SPY by 5% over the next 60 trading days.

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: The Iran ceasefire collapse and U.S. strikes realized the upside oil shock with Brent near $80 intraday, re-priming the energy rotation that was already the top ETF-inflow sector in Q1 2026. The administration's conflict posture and the absence of quick de-escalation favor tighter crude than the broader index is discounting, so XLE should outperform SPY across the shock window.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火破裂以及美国打击已经兑现了油价上行冲击，布伦特盘中接近80美元，重新点燃了2026年一季度本就是ETF流入榜首板块的能源轮动。政府的冲突姿态以及缺乏快速降级安排，使原油供应前景比大盘所定价的更紧，因此XLE在冲击窗口内应跑赢SPY。
evidence: Theater: Iran ceasefire collapsed 7/8; US strikes on Iran 7/8-11; Brent ~$80 intraday
Rotation: energy was top ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026 on the conflict
Watch items: Hormuz transit data, JMIC threat level, CENTCOM strike cadence
theses.dissent: A rapid ceasefire, truce, or Hormuz de-escalation would pop the crude bid and energy equities could give back the entire headline gain quickly.
theses.dissent_zh: 若迅速达成停火、休战或霍尔木兹局势降级，原油溢价会消退，能源股可能迅速回吐全部涨幅。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% over the next 20 trading days.

theses.subject: ITA
theses.thesis: NATO defense spending is a structural super-cycle, and Middle East re-escalation keeps the defense demand bid running independent of oil-price wobbles. The administration's security and budget posture directs capital to primes, missile defense, munitions and shipbuilding, so ITA should outperform SPY on policy-led defense capex.
theses.thesis_zh: 北约国防支出是一个结构性超级周期，中东重新升级使国防需求买盘在油价波动之外仍然持续。政府的安全与预算姿态将资本引向主承包商、导弹防御、弹药和造船，因此ITA应在政策驱动的国防资本开支下跑赢SPY。
evidence: Proxies targeted: ITA, XAR, PPA, SHLD; defense bid persists regardless
Middle East escalation adds a demand/urgency bid separate from oil
theses.dissent: Defense stocks already embed a long build-out; if Washington signals a budget deal that trims procurement growth, ITA multiples can compress against SPY.
theses.dissent_zh: 国防股已计入较长的扩建预期；若华盛顿释放压缩采购增长的预算信号，ITA相对SPY估值可能收缩。

falsifier.text: ITA lags SPY by 5% over the next 60 trading days.

check.note: graded via correlated surrogate XLI (no local series for ITA)

theses.subject: OKLO
theses.thesis: Nuclear-for-AI is a direct industrial-policy lever: the DOE HALEU fuel-bank release and the advanced energy path steer capital toward domestic nuclear developers. OKLO is a policy-sensitive, scorable proxy for that build-out, and under the reflation regime with grid/datacenter capex demand it should outperform SPY.
theses.thesis_zh: 核能服务AI是一项直接的产业政策抓手：DOE的HALEU燃料银行投放以及先进能源路径将资本引向美国国内核电开发商。OKLO是该建设路径下对政策敏感、可评分的代理标的，在再通胀体制叠加电网/数据中心资本开支需求下，应跑赢SPY。
evidence: Rotation theme: Nuclear/uranium/HALEU/fuel cycle; proxies include OKLO, CCJ, LEU, SMR
Open prediction: DOE releases ≥20 MT HALEU into the fuel bank for private/AI projects
Industrial policy steers capital toward strategic domestic capacity
theses.dissent: Nuclear developers are long-duration, execution-heavy and reliant on AI power demand; any AI-capex slowdown or regulatory delay would hit OKLO far more than SPY.
theses.dissent_zh: 核电开发商久期长、执行难度高且依赖AI电力需求；AI资本开支放缓或监管延迟对OKLO的打击会远大于SPY。

falsifier.text: OKLO lags SPY by 8% over the next 60 trading days.
